mechanism: Both drugs can prolong QT interval; moxifloxacin is a fluoroquinolone known for QT prolongation and tolterodine (especially at higher doses) can also prolong QT, creating additive cardiac risk.
action: Monitor ECG and QT interval; use lowest effective doses of tolterodine; consider alternative anticholinergic if possible; avoid in patients with baseline QT prolongation or hypokalemia.
